why: A March 2026 preprint by Matías Bruna, 'A conditional bound for the least prime in an arithmetic progression,' proves p(a,q) ≪_ε q^(2+ε) under the generalized Lindelöf hypothesis, a new conditional result on the least-prime-in-AP quantity central to this problem; an unrelated 2025 Diophantine-tuples paper surfaced noise mentioning 'Linnik constant L=5' but that just restates Xylouris's 2011 unconditional result, not new progress.
